bio.text: Bill Hitchens represents Georgia House District 161.
He is a Marine Corps Vietnam veteran, served 28 years with the Georgia State Patrol, retiring in 1997 as a major, and retired from the Coast Guard Reserve as a commander.
He was the first director of the Georgia Office of Homeland Security beginning in 2003 and became commissioner of the Georgia Department of Public Safety in December 2004.
He is a graduate of Georgia Southern College and the FBI National Academy.
